question: Which title had the most episode views in September 2026?

name: run_sql
purpose: Rank titles by September 2026 episode-view events and show viewer, episode, and access-type composition.
query: SELECT c.title, COUNT(*) AS episode_view_events, COUNT(DISTINCT v.user_id) AS viewers, COUNT(DISTINCT v.content_id || ':' || v.episode_number) AS distinct_episodes, SUM(CASE WHEN v.view_type='free' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS free_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.view_type='sub' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subscription_views, SUM(CASE WHEN v.view_type='ppv' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ppv_views FROM content_views v JOIN content_catalog c ON c.content_id=v.content_id WHERE v.date >= '2026-09-01' AND v.date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY c.content_id, c.title ORDER BY episode_view_events DESC LIMIT 10;

name: run_sql
purpose: Validate September view-type categories, date coverage, and whether episode numbers fall within catalog bounds.
query: SELECT v.view_type, COUNT(*) AS view_events, SUM(CASE WHEN v.episode_number < 1 OR v.episode_number > c.total_episodes OR c.content_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_or_unmatched, MIN(v.date) AS first_date, MAX(v.date) AS last_date FROM content_views v LEFT JOIN content_catalog c ON c.content_id=v.content_id WHERE v.date >= '2026-09-01' AND v.date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY v.view_type ORDER BY v.view_type;

answer:
## Answer
**Midnight Blade** had the most episode views in September 2026, with **4,808 view events**.

## Definition and scope
Counted rows in the episode-view log dated September 1–30, 2026, grouped by title. This counts view events, not unique viewers or distinct episodes.

## Data quality
All September view events had a matching catalog title and an episode number within that title’s episode count. The observed view types were free, subscription, and PPV.
